def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next(( (r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1), None)

    if one is None or two is None:

    r1,c1 = one
    r2,c2 = two
    dr = -1 if r1 > r2 else 1
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
    # Approach marker 2 diagonally while the horizontal gap exceeds the

    r, c = r1 + dr, c1 + dc
    while abs(c2 - c) > abs(r2 - r) and 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]):

        r += dr
        c += dc
    while 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]) and c != c2 - dc:

        c += dc
    return out
